note: 5-star reviews of Winry Stays' Tallahassee listings. All reviews, including lower ratings, are on the Airbnb profile.

reviews.name: Josey (D2E Crew)
reviews.text: The home was spacious, comfortable, and in a convenient location. It worked well for our group and had everything we needed. Overall, we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.name: Joanne
reviews.text: This home met all of our needs spot on. Very spacious, very clear instructions and descriptions were very accurate. Very close to FSU campus, which was key for us. Our host made a check in accommodation for us last minute which was a life-saver! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mario
reviews.text: Had a great stay. Comfortable home in a great location!

reviews.name: Nina
reviews.text: I recommend this host because she never disappoints. Our recent stay was wonderful. Please book with her and you won’t regret it.

reviews.name: Jason
reviews.text: Winry has been super responsive and great at making sure we’re taken care of. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.text: It was a nice place to stay. very convenient to doing work at the university and Publix was close by. mostly made my own food

reviews.name: Kyeisha
reviews.text: The place was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with throughout the trip. Everything went smoothly and we had no issues at all.

reviews.name: Nina
reviews.text: Winry is one of the most responsive hosts I’ve encountered. She always check on you and make sure all is well and whether there is anything else we may need. I certainly recommend her places to anyone looking to rent for a few days or longer. She is a top notch host.

reviews.name: DaVona

reviews.name: Kasandra
reviews.text: Amazing place to stay in Tallahassee! The host was very accommodating, responsive, and helpful. I would absolutely stay here again and recommend this AirBNB to anyone I know!

reviews.name: Katherine
reviews.text: Our stay was excellent, and I’d gladly book this home again for our next project in the area. The host was responsive and welcoming, making the experience even better. The house was spacious and matched the photos perfectly, and the pool along with the peaceful surroundings were definite highlights.

reviews.name: Nina
reviews.text: I highly recommend this home for anyone looking for a clean comfortable and beautiful space.

reviews.name: Tim
reviews.text: The home was clean and freshly redone. The bedrooms were spacious. The area was quiet. My wife and I enjoyed walking through the neighborhood. The price for the proximity to FSU made this home a great place to stay while visiting the FSU track for the FSU relays. The neighborhood was nice and the oak trees are beautiful. It’s about a mile walk, but we were able to walk to the stadium from the home. Overall, my wife and I think this home was a great value and would stay here again when we return in a few months.

reviews.name: Jose
reviews.text: Met and exceeded expectations. Host was responsive to any questions that may have came up. House was great walking distance from restaurants and other things to do. Would book again.

reviews.name: Nina
reviews.text: The home was as described in the advertisement. It was very clean, well decorated and comfortable. The neighborhood is well kept and very serene.

reviews.name: Cain
reviews.text: Great for our team from out of town as a home base!

reviews.name: Yashica
reviews.text: My family and I enjoyed Winry’s home. It looked just like the pictures. The home was very clean and had plenty of towels and wash cloths. The beds were very comfortable as well. I look forward to staying here when it’s warm so that we can enjoy the beautiful back porch and pool.

reviews.name: Janaina
reviews.text: Wonderful weekend in Tallahassee, especially in this sweet house! Thanks for all!!!

reviews.name: Armando
reviews.text: Stayed here for a business trip and it met all my needs. The space was clean, quiet, and exactly as described. Communication with the host was prompt and professional.

reviews.text: We stayed for a FSU game and it was a great location. Close enough to the stadium and downtown but far enough to be peaceful. The house was very clean and we really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.name: Zachary
reviews.text: They were quite accommodating and helpful when I had special needs near the end of my stay. I am thankful for their flexibility and willingness to work to find a win-win solution.

reviews.name: Andrea
reviews.text: The house is prettier in person than the pics. Our group consisted of 4 adults and 2 teenagers. We all felt at home the minute we walked in the door. Myself being a FSU fan. The first thing I noticed was the FSU Welcome sign above the fire place. Don’t let that deter you from staying if you’re not a FSU fan. This house has so many other great qualities to consider when looking for a place to stay. Such as large bedrooms, big backyard and great host. 😊

reviews.name: Tyler
reviews.text: Super responsive and accommodating host. Location was minutes from FSU campus. Would stay again for game weekend

reviews.name: Karen
reviews.text: Hephzibah was very responsive when we struggled getting in. (It was our fault we were struggling) Everything was exactly as described. Anytime we are in Florida we will be looking to see if this spot is available first!

reviews.name: Geoff
reviews.text: We had a great day, we were in town on work, but the host was very accommodating and very responsive with any questions or issues that we had. I would stay again if ever back in the area.

reviews.name: Sharon
reviews.text: Winry’s listing was clean and had most of what we needed.

reviews.name: Marlene
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay and plan to keep this at the top of the list for future visits!

reviews.name: Sabrina
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this Airbnb. The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, making check-in and communication super easy. The location was perfect—close to everything I needed. I’d definitely stay here again!

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: We were in Tallahassee on business. The home was very roomy and clean all the beds were comfortable according to my men mine was also nice. Tv in every room which is rare from my experience staying at bbs which is quite often. I highly recommend this home when visiting Tallahassee. Oh, the A/C kept up nicely with Florida’s less than Northern heat.

reviews.name: Kyle
reviews.text: Great place to stay! My kids loved the pool and the home is nicely furnished.

reviews.name: Kristina
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Hephzibah’s place. We were very comfortable.

reviews.name: Karai
reviews.text: Yu’s place was great stay at for our visit to Tallahassee. The home was full of open space for my family to enjoy together. This is a good place to stay for a family visiting Tallahassee for the first time.

reviews.name: April
reviews.text: Spacious, clean home in a good location. Thanks again for everything!
